title: [TASK] Archive shelves
body:
## What to build

Shelf owners can archive a shelf from the Shelves screen. Archived shelves leave the header total and move to an Archived tab, where a shelf archived more than 90 days ago can be purged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each active shelf on the Shelves screen shows an Archive button to its owner
- [ ] Archiving a shelf removes it from the shelf total in the Shelves header
- [ ] A shelf archived more than 90 days ago shows a Purge button on the Archived tab
